data.title: 夏洛特 · 晨曦床单的娇羞初醒
data.description: 清晨的柔和光线穿过白色纱帘照在凌乱的被褥上。夏洛特侧躺在枕头边，娇小的身躯裹在宽大的纯白羽绒被中，只露出圆润白皙的香肩与粉嫩的锁骨。浅金色发丝散乱在枕套上，她拉起被角遮住半张通红的脸颊，碧蓝眼眸清澈微漾，轻声吐露着清晨的动人问候。
data.location: sunlit bedroom with rumpled white linen sheets
data.action: 侧躺在枕头边，娇小的身躯裹在宽大的纯白羽绒被中
data.lighting: soft diffused morning sunbeam casting delicate highlights on white linen
data.promptProse: Lying on her side tucked beneath a fluffy white duvet in a bright morning bedroom, Charlotte Dunois wears a delicate peach silk camisole trimmed with French lace. Peeking shyly over the crumpled sheets with bare shoulders and a rosy blush in her warm orange eyes, she basks in gentle diffused morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side nestled under a fluffy white duvet with her lace-trimmed peach silk camisole slipping at her bare shoulders, she peeks shyly over the sheets with bright, flustered embarrassment. Soft morning sunbeams illuminate the rumpled pillows.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a soft peach silk camisole trimmed with delicate French lace and an empire ribbon, peeking above the fluffy white duvet draped over her waist.
